name: carpenter_n_walk_v01
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: hand-painted NONPIXEL miniature NPC four-frame animation. Input image is the EXACT canonical single neutral model, not a suggestion. Keep the same compact 2.7-head proportions and SAME skull size, face angle, crown, shoulders, torso, pelvis and costume. Warm copper-auburn hair in a high long ponytail, soft side bangs, amber-brown eyes, small gold leaf ponytail tie, human round ears. Ivory rolled/puffed-sleeve blouse, indigo-blue work apron dress with broad front bib, tan-gold stitching, small pale botanical trim at hem, brown leather waistbelt and TWO different work pouches (one on each hip), small carving chisel/woodworking tools safely STOWED in belt loops. Bare knees and brown sturdy ankle-to-mid-calf lace-up boots. Hands relaxed and empty in this turnaround, no hammer raised and no weapon. Preserve her practical carpenter costume and recognizable high ponytail exactly from portrait, no armor or adventurer hood. Camera locked to straight BACK, looking away upward; never turn head/body. Draw one slow in-place WALK CYCLE, four DISTINCT chronological poses in 2x2 reading order. Frame1 anatomical RIGHT leg (screen RIGHT) strides away/up, LEFT leg trails down. Frame2 RIGHT planted under pelvis while LEFT knee swings away. Frame3 LEFT leg (screen LEFT) strides away/up and RIGHT trails down with sole visible. Frame4 LEFT planted and RIGHT knee swings away. Alternate screen-left and screen-right trailing boot. Keep upper body upright, pelvis height and leg/boot lengths constant. Hands/props retain original low carrying position, no extra hand. Small cloth/ponytail sway only. Lower legs must visibly exchange front/back ownership; DO NOT repeat same leading leg in frame3. Composition: four separate COMPLETE full-body figures in equal2x2 cells. Each figure occupies ONLY 70% of cell height with 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT border ABOVE hair, BELOW soles, and around all props. Generous margin especially ponytail/ahoge. Each has exactly2 arms/2 hands/2 legs. No cut-off body edges or touching cells. Refined broad soft-painted shading exactly matching reference. True transparent RGBA background; no shadow/floor, letters/numbers/gridlines, particles, props not in model, camera change, growth/shrink, alternate costume, labels or backdrop. Preserve anatomical accessory sides.
